text.transcript: I am obsessed with Sonder. There is something so fascinating but also oddly unnerving, thinking about how everyone around you, everyone who is living, has their own unique story to tell, with irreplicable details. No two people will ever live the same life. These thoughts can make you feel so special, but also tremendously unimportant in the grand scheme of the world. Capturing slivers of strangers' lives through my camera is a way of preserving the unique story, as almost all of these moments will be forgotten with the passage of time. I guess it's just my way of coping with these disconcerting thoughts, but it makes me wonder, does anyone else feel this way?
